name: pdf-viewer
//nohoist: The React Native CLI is split across several packages that require each other by bare name. Hoisting some to the root while npm keeps others (and react-native-macos) in app/node_modules breaks that resolution: react-native-macos's own react-native.config.js then throws, and the CLI reports no platforms and no commands — no `start`, no `run-macos`. Keeping the whole toolchain in one tree is what makes them resolvable.
